title: Durably record the release receipt ref and worker handoff binding for a released attempt
description:
Objective: produce the last two `ExpansionReleaseEvidence` facts that no production path writes and no other producer task claims. Producer repair for task-e62e3828df234c66969a99b8223487f4, whose rail 1 states: "if it omits a named fact, repair that producer rather than reconstructing authority here."

MEASURED GAP at HEAD a42ae2f, re-measured field by field (the earlier fa39721 measurement still holds; nothing landed in between). `ExpansionReleaseEvidence` (packages/core/src/expansion/expansion-planning-hold.ts:27-36) declares 17 fields. Three sibling producer tasks already cover thirteen of them:
- task-740924b741754955b94a7ccf7fc16bb1 (PLANNING) -> reason, disposition{resumable,strongestReason,terminalTarget}, attemptState, leaseRef, leaseState, providerSlotRef, providerSlotState.
- task-6d40078159e84d92b3293d7b366cf727 (PLANNING) -> effectsTerminal, terminalEffectRefs, resourcesTerminal, terminalResourceRefs.
- task-ded026d6587442eabc28ff2609d231aa (PLANNING) -> safeBoundaryObserved, observationRef.
Two more are derivable by the reader itself: `attemptRef` (the durable attempt record already carries attemptAggregateId/attemptId) and `truthClass` (the reader stamps DAEMON_VERIFIED only because it read durable bytes).

THAT LEAVES EXACTLY TWO WITH NO PRODUCER AND NO OWNER, WHICH IS THIS TASK:
- `receiptRef` — `grep -rn "receiptRef" apps packages adapters --include=*.ts | grep -v expansion-planning-hold` returns SEVEN hits and every one is a test or a testkit fixture (packages/scheduler/src/expansion/expansion-current-hold.test.ts:66, index-surface.test.ts:870 and :1411, packages/testkit/src/foundation/foundation-journey-fixtures.ts:40,60, foundation-model-j1.ts:49, foundation-spec.test.ts:64). Zero production writers anywhere in the repo.
- `handoff: ExpansionHandoffBinding {digest, ref}` — `grep -rn "workerHandoff\|handoffDigest\|HandoffRecorded\|handoffRef" apps/daemon/src --include=*.ts | grep -v "test\|fixtures"` returns ZERO. No durable worker-handoff record exists in the daemon at all.

WHY THE HANDOFF IS LOAD-BEARING, NOT COSMETIC: core's `safeRelease` predicate (expansion-planning-hold.ts:209-215) admits a hold only when, among ten other conjuncts, `same(value.handoff, command.workerHandoff)` — the release evidence's handoff must deep-equal the handoff the create command carries. With no durable producer the daemon can only echo the caller, which is precisely the caller-supplied authority the epic forbids. `receiptRef` is NOT inside `safeRelease`, but the `release()` parser (:147) lists it among the required keys, so a release object without it fails to parse and the hold is unbuildable.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS AND MUST BE COMPOSED, NOT REBUILT: the durable attempt record `attemptRecordBody` (apps/daemon/src/work/foundation-attempt-contracts.ts:182-199) already carries activationDigest, attemptAggregateId, attemptId, effectId, grantId, inputManifest, nodeKey, observation, reasonCode, reasonLayer, registration, resultManifest, sessionId, stderrSha256, stdoutSha256, truthClass and wrapperIdentity — write the two new bindings alongside it on the same production release path rather than opening a second record family. A durable byte-checked evidence receipt ALSO already exists one epic over: `readStoredReceipt` in apps/daemon/src/evidence/foundation-verification-store.ts:109 returns a re-encoded, byte-compared row carrying `receiptSha256` and `receipt.graphIdentity`. If `receiptRef` is bound to that receipt, the binding must be recorded durably here — the reader in task-e62e3828 must never go looking for "some receipt that plausibly matches".

Deliverable: a durable record, written on the production release path, carrying the released attempt's `receiptRef` and its `{digest, ref}` worker handoff binding, both resolved from durable authority. Facts only — this task creates no hold, no PlanningRun, and grants no authority.

NOT in scope: the release disposition / lease / slot state (task-740924b7), terminal effect and resource refs (task-6d400781), the safe-boundary observation (task-ded026d6), the evidence reader itself (task-e62e3828), scheduler admission, or approval.

Owned paths: one new module under apps/daemon/src/work/ plus its `.js` bridge and focused test. Every sibling module in that directory has a committed one-line `export * from "./<name>.ts";` bridge; without it the module is invisible at runtime while tsc and vitest both stay green.

Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test — read the OUTPUT `Test Files N passed` count line, not the exit code. Daemon gates can be red at baseline from foreign in-flight slices; apply the path-attributed baseline over the owned paths.
definitionOfDone: The two bindings are written by the PRODUCTION release path, not by a fixture: `grep -rn "receiptRef" apps/daemon/src --include=*.ts | grep -v '\.test\.' | grep -v fixtures` returns a producer where it returned zero, and the same grep shape for the handoff binding returns a producer where `workerHandoff|handoffDigest|HandoffRecorded|handoffRef` returned zero.

The record carries `receiptRef` and a handoff `{digest, ref}` whose shape satisfies core's `handoff()` parser (packages/core/src/expansion/expansion-planning-hold.ts:140), and a test reads BOTH back from durable bytes rather than from the writing call's return value.

The handoff digest is recomputed from the referenced bytes on read, not trusted: a test writes a record whose stored digest does not match the referenced content and asserts an exact code and layer refusing it, rather than a record that decodes and passes.

A caller-supplied `receiptRef` or handoff that contradicts the durable authority does NOT win: a test supplies a contradicting caller value and asserts the durable value is recorded, pinning the exact code and layer of whichever layer refused.

Absent, ambiguous, foreign-project and unreadable receipt/handoff records each return a DISTINCT stable code — absent and ambiguous never share one, because zero rows and two rows demand opposite repairs — and none of them yields a binding.
A mutation that makes the handoff comparison always true, and separately one that hardcodes a non-empty `receiptRef`, each turn a NAMED test red; record the test name for both drills.

`pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` run with exit codes captured separately, the test leg prints a nonzero `Test Files N passed` count line, and the HEAD-minus-merge-base failing-path delta over the owned paths is EMPTY.
taskRails: No caller-supplied ref, digest, truth class or handoff may become authority; missing or unverifiable evidence stays UNKNOWN and never gains authority.

Use public package roots across package boundaries; no deep imports. If a symbol is consumed from another workspace package, verify the dependency edge (consumer package.json dependency, pnpm-lock importer entry, and a compiled bare-specifier probe) before naming it - there is no tsconfig paths escape hatch and a deep relative import fails TS6059.

Exact codes and layers on every refusal path, positive generated counts on any sweep, target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400. The new module needs its committed .js bridge in the same commit.
blockedReason: Fresh measurement shows AF cannot safely write a standalone binding. There is no attempt-level RELEASED transaction or handoff record/ref; current work.release releases only an advisory claim. Design section 12.4 requires release + exact checkpoint/handoff atomically or none. `receiptRef` must be the nested byte-verified EvidenceReceipt.sha256 from readStoredReceipt, bound to the same attempt/graph/lease/effect—not verificationId or the daemon row digest. The handoff must be recomputed with public @moe/context.createReleaseHandoff from durable contextManifestDigest, journalDigest, graphReference, leaseReference and receiptRef, but daemon has no @moe/context edge and no production context/journal records. Filed task-203a5ca7 for the exact attempt context manifest and task-04dd5a0a for attempt journal authority; notified task-740924b7's architect that 740 must define the stable handoff ref and atomic release writer/reader. Re-plan AF only after task-740924b7, task-203a5ca7 and task-04dd5a0a are DONE.

priorHandoffs.whatIsDone: Measured receipt/handoff meanings, notified task-740 architect of atomic release requirements, filed task-203a5ca7 (exact context manifest) and task-04dd5a0a (attempt journal), and blocked AF on them plus task-740.
priorHandoffs.whatRemains: After prerequisites, add @moe/context edge and plan one module/bridge/test to verify nested receipt sha, recompute createReleaseHandoff, compare the release transaction's stored binding, and expose strict readback.
priorHandoffs.pitfalls: receiptRef is nested EvidenceReceipt.sha256, not verificationId or row digest; never trust the stored handoff digest without recomputation; no separate pre/post release write.
priorHandoffs.openQuestions: task-740 must freeze the stable handoff ref naming rule; do not infer ref=digest unless its contract says so.
priorHandoffs.reason: Explicit measured prerequisite handoff; continuing user-requested plan-all sweep.
